```java
public static String extractKnowledgeData(KnowledgeRsp knowledgeRsp) {

    if (knowledgeRsp.getProperties() != null) {
```

```java
    if (knowledgeRsp == null) {
        return null;
    }
    Map<String, Object> properties = knowledgeRsp.getProperties();
    if (properties != null && properties.containsKey("links")) {
        Object linksValue = properties.get("links");
        if (linksValue instanceof String && !((String) linksValue).isEmpty()) {
            return (String) linksValue;
        }
    }
    return knowledgeRsp.getKnowledge();
}
```
